shape.text: A bot token begins xoxb-. Slack's tokens page states that Slack tokens are divided into dash-separated sections with the secret last, in its user-token section with an xoxp- example, and gives no section widths or alphabet for xoxb-.
Scanner rules read two numeric sections of 10 to 13 digits each, followed by an alphanumeric secret. These widths are agreement among tools, not a Slack statement.

With token rotation, exchanging a granular bot token returns an access token with a new xoxe. prefix, shown as xoxe.xoxb-1-... in an elided example, and a refresh token shown as xoxe-1-.... The access token lasts 43,200 seconds. This form is outside the contract grammar and is not a benign control.
Workflow tokens are described as a subset of bot tokens but begin xwfp-, and the page contrasts them with xoxb- tokens.
